title: Cloak of Cunning Brume

sources.title: Cunning Brume
markers: | description = When the wearer {{SmSAI|Disengage|Disengages}}, they also create a foggy cloud with {{dist|m=2}} radius that lasts for 1 turn.

summary: Disengage while in combat to create a 7 ft-radius fog cloud that obscures and blinds creatures within. Cautious Healer does not trigger it.

fields.Duration: The pinned page describes one turn in the passive and lists two turns in the area field.
fields.Trigger: Works with Disengage, Cunning Action: Disengage, Disengage: Bonus Action and Step of the Wind: Disengage during combat.
fields.Base value: 70 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
